description: This file implements a key-value service for Mattermost plugins, providing methods to set, get, delete, and list key-value pairs with options for atomic operations, expiry, and filtering.

classes.name: KVService
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with key-value storage for the active plugin.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with optional parameters for atomicity and expiry.

methods.name: SetAtomicWithRetries
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-set operation with retries.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key into the provided interface.
